# launch.arr.club

> The launch board for AI startups where revenue is the headline. Founders publish a permanent product page,
> get a dofollow backlink, and can optionally share revenue to be tracked long-term on ARR.Club.

## Key pages

- Launch board: https://launch.arr.club/
- Submit your product: https://launch.arr.club/submit.html
- Weekly archive: https://launch.arr.club/2026/w40/
- Product Hunt alternative: https://launch.arr.club/alternatives/product-hunt/
- FasLaunch alternative: https://launch.arr.club/alternatives/faslaunch/
- Launch your startup: https://launch.arr.club/launch-your-startup/
- Launch your AI tool: https://launch.arr.club/launch-your-ai-tool/
- Launch your SaaS: https://launch.arr.club/launch-your-saas/
- Privacy: https://launch.arr.club/privacy.html

## Submit

Founders submit at https://launch.arr.club/submit.html — badge-verified launches are free and dofollow,
instant listing is $5 one-time. Sharing revenue is optional; shared revenue may be tracked on ARR.Club (https://arr.club).
